description: This file defines a PHP trait named LockTrait that provides methods for managing named locks using database queries, specifically interacting with MySQL lock functions (GET_LOCK, IS_FREE_LOCK, RELEASE_LOCK). It is part of the Goteo project and utilizes the Model class for database operations.

methods.name: isNamedLocked
methods.description: Checks if a lock with the given name is currently locked by querying the database.

methods.name: getNamedLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a named lock; returns true if successful.

methods.name: releaseNamedLock
methods.description: Releases a named lock and confirms whether the lock was successfully released.
